posts.title: Top 5 Cybersecurity Essentials Every Business Must Implement in 2026
posts.tags: cyber hygiene, security tips, best practices
posts.excerpt: The critical security controls and organisational hygiene every business needs to defend against ransomware and data exfiltration.
posts.content:
In modern corporate networks, perimeter defense alone is no longer sufficient. Organizations must transition to a zero-trust model where every access request is verified and inspected.

Key steps include multi-factor authentication (MFA), strict role-based access control, automated offsite encrypted backups, continuous vulnerability scanning, and employee phishing awareness drills.
